files.content:
# Pixel Monthly Budget

A fully offline, single-page budget tracker built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Features

- Set your monthly income
- Add expenses with a category (Food, Rent, Fun, Other) and amount
- See the remaining money after expenses
- Visual bars per category showing spending proportions
- Remaining amount turns red when negative
- Keyboard accessible with labeled controls
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- Cohesive dark theme with gold accent

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Files

- `index.html` — structure
- `styles.css` — styling
- `app.js` — logic

## Accessibility

- All inputs have associated `<label>` elements
- Focus outlines and hover/pressed states are visible
- The remaining amount uses an `aria-live` region for screen reader updates

## Constraints

- No external dependencies, network requests, or assets
- Uses only relative paths
- Pure CSS graphics (bars) and system fonts
